approved_claim_dependencies.claim: A workflow Electronic Signature action can use a fixed document template or resolve a template ID or GUID from a workflow attribute; the fixed template setting takes precedence when both are supplied.

source_refs.title: Use Electronic Signatures in a Workflow

approved_claim_dependencies.claim: In Rock electronic signatures, Applies To identifies the subject of the document, Assigned To identifies the expected signer, and Signed By records the person who completed the signature.
An entity document type binds stored documents to both a Rock entity type and a file type, and optional qualifier column and value settings can restrict it to a subset such as one Group Type.
Rock recommends typed signatures because a drawn signature is personally identifiable information that can create additional legal obligations when stored in Rock.
